title: Categorical evaluation tensor cube transport
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes, and a level $n\geq0$ denoting the quotient $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$. Use the coherent sequence categories and their exact derived inverse image $F$ and tensor comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], the finite intrinsic derived pullback $G$ and canonical comparison $\nu$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction], and the evaluation functors $V_X,V_Y$ and their normalized tensor comparisons $\tau_X,\tau_Y$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $c$ be an ordinary comparison from integralOperationsLevelPullback at n to the intrinsic constant-coefficient inverse image, preserving the actual adjunction-unit sections of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]: for every module A, object U and section x, c sends the first unit applied to x to the second unit applied to x. Let $e:F V_X\simeq V_Y G$ be a derived comparison whose square on every cochain complex is the descent of pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex.inv followed by the termwise image of c, with the specified exact-functor factorization isomorphisms. This square is exactly the binder he in the Lean statement below. For K-flat coherent cochain complexes P,Q in [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], put M=Q(P), N=Q(Q). Then, with composition written in traversal order,
$$V_X(\mu_{M,N})\,\tau^X_{FM,FN}\,(e_M\otimes e_N)=e_{M\otimes N}\,G(\tau^Y_{M,N})\,\nu_{V_YM,V_YN}.$$
Only pairs of the displayed K-flat representatives are asserted; extension to arbitrary derived objects is a separate step. No boundedness, constructibility or termwise flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Pull back the K-flat sequence complexes and evaluate them. Evaluation preserves their K-flatness. The ordinary inverse-evaluation mate followed by c identifies the two finite complexes, so K-flatness transports to the intrinsic finite pullbacks. Apply finite K-flat tensor normalization to obtain the generator-normalized ordinary finite comparison k and its canonical derived tensor-model equation.

Apply the proved ordinary generator computation, its quotient image, and exact-functor naturality to obtain the total diagonal. Invoke the conditional tensor-model pasting theorem with this diagonal and the finite K-flat normalization. Its assumptions are precisely the already obtained K-flat model properties and faces.

theorem completedPullbackTensor_evaluation_cube_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (c : integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n ≅
      sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f)
    (hc : ∀ (A : normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) (U : Y.ProEt)
      (x : A.val.obj (op U)),
      (c.hom.app A).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (((coefficientProEtaleModuleAdjunction.{u, u} f
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))))).unit.app A).val.app (op U) x) =
      ((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app A).val.app (op U) x)
    (e : pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f ⋙
        coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n ≅
      coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n ⋙ finiteDerivedPullback l E n f)
    (he : ∀ A : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ,
      e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj A) ≫
        (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app A) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicPullback
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ =
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app A) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f n).inv.app A) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c (.up ℤ)).hom.app
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj A)))
    (hn : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E Y
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction)
    (hx : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E X
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) Q) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
      ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).evaluationTensor n).hom.app
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M,
          (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj N) ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom (e.hom.app M)
          (e.hom.app N)) =
    e.hom.app
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        (((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).evaluationTensor n).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (finitePullbackTensorConstructionIso l E f n).hom.app
      ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj M,
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj N)
